overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission approved several one-day alcohol licenses for upcoming community events and tabled an update on Ocean State Job Lot's DUA certificate. The commission also discussed state license quota restrictions, Common Victualler hour alignments, and efforts to streamline annual renewal inspections across city departments.

items.title: Approval of January 17, 2024 Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the meeting held on January 17, 2024.

items.title: Event Them One-Day License Applications
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for Event Them to host a family event on March 2 and a video game tournament on March 3, 2024.

items.title: Mary Queen of Peace Parish One-Day License Application
items.summary: Approved a one-day all-alcohol license for Mary Queen of Peace Parish for an April 28, 2024 cornhole tournament fundraiser, contingent on receiving an insurance binder.

items.title: Medford Historical Society One-Day License Applications
items.summary: Approved two one-day licenses for poetry reading events at the Medford Historical Society on April 4 and April 25, 2024.

items.title: Ocean State Job Lot DUA Certificate
items.summary: Tabled review of Ocean State Job Lot's DUA certificate update because the applicant had not yet provided the required paperwork.

items.title: Licensing Discussion and Interdepartmental Coordination
items.summary: Discussed statutory license quota timelines, Section 15 license options, Common Victualler hour restrictions, and plans to coordinate with city departments to streamline annual renewal inspections.
